title: Quest XR Renderer Hotfix · v0.4.1
changes: Fixed the XR WebGL texture creation exception (texParameteri now receives three required arguments).
Disabled XR multisampling for Quest Browser compatibility; the original source photo and collection remain unchanged.
Removed an import of a Three.js file that did not exist in the release; the landing scene uses the pinned CDN with an offline CSS fallback.
Nginx now returns HTTP 404 for missing assets instead of returning the HTML homepage as a JavaScript module.
Added pre-deployment guards against missing local modules and invalid WebGL texture calls, and a live JavaScript MIME smoke test.
No changes to saved captures, profiles, encrypted provider keys, or billable request limits.
